newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Marlin boosts granite operation with buys.
newsitem.headline: Marlin boosts granite operation with buys.

text.p: South African group Marlin Corp Ltd (Marcorp) on Thursday said it had expanded its granite operations by making two buys from the Everite Group Ltd.

The firm said it sealed a deal to acquire certain assets of Everite's granite quarrying division at Marikana, just north of Johannesburg, for 5.92 million rand. The quarry currently produces about 700 cubic metres of Rustenburg granite a month.

The group also announced that Minaco Granite and Marble Ltd, which is 71 percent owned by Marlin, had bought certain assets of Everite's granite beneficiation division at Marikana for 8.10 million rand.
"The acquisitions will expand Marcorp and Minaco quarrying and beneficiation activities and enable them to further entrench their position in the granite industry," the firms said in a statement.

The firms said the historical performance of the acquired units was not an accurate indicator of future potential as neither buy included any taking over of debt or responsibility for Everite employees.
